_about: Notes: your inner voice on the slate (docs/master-design.md §5). First person, hedged, short. A thought has stages that change as you act; answering it writes its journal line and may raise the next question. Fills in {braces} come from the game.

stages.start: The dial says the cabin air's good for about a sol. After that I'm living off the suit.
stages.low: Cabin air's getting thin. Whatever's under that parachute, I need it soon.
stages.carrying: Got the cartridge. Twenty kilos of it. Back to the cabin.

air.journal: Plugged the new cartridge into the cabin. The needle swung right over. I can breathe for days now.

stages.start: Parachute on the ridge {dir} of the hatch. Life support, I hope.
stages.near: It's ours. A pallet in the dust by the canopy, latches still shut.
stages.open: Pallet's open. The sample kit, and a fresh oxygen cartridge for the cabin.

parachute.journal: Found the first pallet under its parachute, right where the orbiter's photo said.

stages.start: Castellanos says a dozen pallets came down in the storm. That's eleven still out there somewhere.

cargo.journal: Every pallet is home, or as home as they'll get.

stages.start: Someone in training swore Martian sunsets are blue. I'd like to see one for myself.

sunset.journal: Watched the sun go down from outside. It really is blue round the sun, like cold glass. Nobody said how quiet it would be.

stages.start: ARDEN doesn't think the cabin battery lasts the night. There's a power pallet out there. Before dark would be better.
stages.night: Dark now. Heat or lights through the night: I don't think the battery gives me both.

stages.start: Long day. The landing seats recline. I could sleep till dawn, or I could go and look at the stars.
Cold in here. The heater's on the wall switch, if the battery can spare it.

cold.journal: Warm again. I'd forgotten how much I like my fingers.

stages.start: From up here I can see two more parachutes. One off to the {a}, one to the {b}.

chutes.journal: Two more parachutes from the ridge, and both pallets found.

stages.near: This pallet's flat and wide. Could be the power kit ARDEN wants.
stages.open: A rolled solar blanket and a battery pack. Lay it out by the lander and the heater can run all night.

power_pallet.journal: Laid pallet 2's solar blanket out by the lander and plugged its battery in. Warm nights now, if the sun does its part.

stages.near: There's a cradle in this one the shape of GAR-Y. Please be in there.

stages.start: GAR-Y keeps turning towards the {dir}. A pallet beacon, maybe, too faint for my suit.
stages.near: Frost on the ground in this hollow, and a pallet sitting in it.

tools.journal: Pallet 4, in the frost hollow: a rock hammer, a headlamp and a patch kit. The headlamp throws a lot more light than the suit lamp.

sunset_gary.journal: Watched the sun go down with GAR-Y. Neither of us made a sound. It's the first time it's felt like we live here.

not_alone.journal: Not alone out here after all. GAR-Y sticks so close it bumps my boots.

stages.start: Something is tapping on the hull outside the hatch. Something small, and patient.

tapping.journal: There was something tapping on the hull when I came round. It was GAR-Y.
